about: The text every Agora page shares, kept as one noun: the navigation, the agent banner, the endpoints, the deck viewer's labels and the footer. scripts/build_site.py renders it into every page that is not frozen. Fields ending in _html hold trusted markup; every other field is plain text.

banner.lead: Copy these instructions into your AI agent, and it can connect, claim work and report back.
banner.fine_print: Copying the brief issues no credentials and starts no work by itself.

deck.help_html: Use the arrow keys or swipe to change slides; on a slide wider than the window, the arrow keys scroll it first. Once a slide or a deck button has focus, <kbd>N</kbd> shows the speaker notes and <kbd>O</kbd> the outline.
